answer: Operator liability escrow pool ties every identity to one shared reserve; fraud drains it and freezes all that operator’s identities, not just the wallet. The operator posts a fixed reserve per active identity, with an anchor record mapping each to its operator. A renewal needs a cedar-signed coverage attestation. A pigment key-marker binds the operator’s hardware to that record, so each clone costs one full per-identity reserve plus total-pool forfeiture risk.
